'''Bakash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Bakash and the men he commanded were stationed on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] where they were sent to the [[Lower Wilds]] region. There they were driven mad by an unknown force and became hostile to their former allies. Bakash was killed, along with his men by a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who was sent to wipe out the insane soldiers.
